title: Add the dual-license and compatibility release record
description:
The repository and release inputs carry complete legal text plus a canonical changelog and v1.0 compatibility/upgrade record.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: LICENSE-MIT and LICENSE-APACHE contain the complete texts matching the MIT OR Apache-2.0 manifest expression and are included by artifact manifests.
- [hard] REQ-02: CHANGELOG and the v1.0 release-note source state supported capabilities, compatibility boundaries, upgrade expectations, and intentional packaging removals without repeating installation commands.
- [hard] REQ-03: A release metadata check fails when either license text, the v1.0 changelog entry, or the compatibility/upgrade record is absent from the release inputs.

## Notes

Blast radius: repository-root license/changelog files, the canonical release-note source, and release metadata validation; install/deployment commands remain in canonical user guides.
